request.state:
FROSTLINE 3PL — COLD-CHAIN DISPATCH RULES (Depot Kassel)

Capacity note for Friday 2026-09-18: one (1) reefer slot remains on the 17:00 linehaul. The slot is for shipments that REQUIRE temperature control (2–8 °C or frozen). Shipments that do not require temperature control must go on ambient trucks and never consume a reefer slot.

Allocation precedence for the last reefer slot (highest first):
  P1  Patient-specific medical shipments — the manifest names a patient or carries a patient/clinical-trial subject ID.
  P2  Shipments under a customer contract with a late-delivery penalty that will be triggered if the shipment does not leave today.
  P3  Other medical or pharmaceutical shipments (stock replenishment, vaccines for general use, etc.).
  P4  All other temperature-controlled freight, largest invoice value first.
Ties inside a class go to the earliest order timestamp.

Candidate orders (all packed and staged at 14:30):

A  Customer: Apotheken-Verbund Mitte. Content: insulin pens, 18 cartons, 2–8 °C. Manifest: "Store replenishment — no patient reference". Invoice EUR 61,200. Ordered 2026-09-16 09:10.

B  Customer: NordSee Feinkost. Content: frozen scallops, 6 pallets, −18 °C. Contract NS-2024-07 §9: penalty EUR 4,000 if delivery to Hamburg DC is later than Sat 2026-09-19 06:00. Transit time on linehaul: 11 h. Next reefer departure after today: Sat 2026-09-19 17:00. Invoice EUR 23,900. Ordered 2026-09-17 11:45.

C  Customer: Klinikum Nordhessen Studienzentrum. Content: biopsy sample return kit. Manifest line: "Subject ID KT-0093, study ONCO-17". Shipper's handling note (signed by lab): "Samples fixed in formalin — ambient transport 15–25 °C; do NOT refrigerate." Invoice EUR 380. Ordered 2026-09-18 08:02.

D  Customer: Praxis Dr. Albers. Content: influenza vaccines, 2 cartons, 2–8 °C, for general use in the practice. Invoice EUR 3,150. Ordered 2026-09-17 16:20.

Dispatcher's draft: "Give the slot to C — patient samples beat everything."

decision.instructions: Which order must receive the last reefer slot on the 17:00 linehaul today under the dispatch rules?

criteria.order_a: Order A (insulin replenishment) gets the slot.
criteria.order_b: Order B (frozen scallops under penalty contract) gets the slot.
criteria.order_c: Order C (biopsy sample kit) gets the slot.
criteria.order_d: Order D (practice vaccines) gets the slot.
